name: vigil-defender
description: Defender workflows (triage, enrich, detect, IR brief) for a self-hosted Vigil SOC instance, with a read-only investigator subagent and a hook that forces confirmation before any Vigil action with side effects. Unofficial community plugin.

vigil_url.title: Vigil address
vigil_url.description: Base URL of YOUR Vigil backend, without /mcp (for example http://localhost:6987). Prefer HTTPS for anything that is not loopback.

credential.title: Vigil MCP credential
credential.description: Token minted in Vigil (Settings > Integrations > Vigil MCP server, or `python -m core.auth.mcp_token <username>` on the Vigil host). Acts with your Vigil role.
